object.title: Ivanov's metaconjecture on automorphisms of rich surface objects
object.statement: Let $S$ be a surface, and let an object be naturally associated to $S$ and have sufficiently rich structure. **Ivanov's metaconjecture.** Every such object has the extended mapping class group ${\operatorname{Map}^\pm}(S)$ as its group of automorphisms. This metaconjecture describes a pattern in which sufficiently rich objects associated to finite-type surfaces are characterized by the action of the extended mapping class group; the paper explains that it does not extend to simultaneous flip graphs of infinite-type surfaces.
object.source_name: Assaf Bar-Natan, Advay Goel, Brendan Halstead, Paul Hamrick, Sumedh Shenoy and Rishi Verma, “Big Flip Graphs and Their Automorphism Groups”, arXiv:2201.11272 (2022).
object.references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2020–2022). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2010.13169](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.13169).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.11272

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2022).
